meta.name: Haunted Hotel
meta.description: After inheriting a hotel from her late brother, a single mom moves in with his good-natured ghost — and high-maintenance guests who will never check out.

videos.title: Welcome to the Undervale
videos.overview: Desperate to attract paying customers, Katherine hires an exorcist to get rid of the hotel's ghosts. Ben finds an unexpected soul mate.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: Katherine is concerned that a rebellious ghost is a bad influence on Esther. A power outage sends Nathan, Ben and Abaddon into the woods.

videos.title: Randy Slasher
videos.overview: While Katherine summons the courage to go out on a date, the rest of the crew deals with a creepy killer who targets lusty teens.

videos.title: How to Train Your Demon
videos.overview: Abaddon struggles to control his instincts, Katherine bumps into a business rival, and Nathan, Ben and Esther investigate a possible werewolf.

videos.title: Rollyfluffs
videos.overview: Esther's plan to become more popular backfires when she starts a dangerous new trend at school. The hotel's honeymoon suite turns on the charm.

videos.title: Ghost Hunters!
videos.overview: A ghost-hunting reality show films an episode at the Undervale. Ben opens up to an enchanted diary and shares all his relationship drama.

videos.title: Seven Deadly Bens
videos.overview: Ben's desire to be more confident spawns multiple personalities. Meanwhile, Nathan keeps falling through floors... but why?

videos.title: Aunt Rose
videos.overview: A curmudgeonly relative comes to visit — with no plans to leave. Abaddon is outsmarted by a doorstop, and Esther experiments with raising the dead.

videos.title: The Esthercist
videos.overview: Esther takes charge when soul-sucking demons invade the hotel. Katherine shares a painful truth with Nathan about his death.

videos.title: The Acolytes of Abaddon
videos.overview: The good news? There's a busload of red-cloaked customers who want to stay at the Undervale. The bad news? They might be part of a world-ending cult.

videos.title: Ooze
videos.overview: With business picking up at the Undervale, Katherine is hiring for help. But can the perfect candidate survive the hotel's frightful working conditions?

videos.title: Dinner Party
videos.overview: Katherine braces for an unwelcome surprise as Ben throws a hauntingly awkward dinner party for Annabelle. Esther and Abaddon's friendship is tested.

videos.title: The Witch
videos.overview: While Katherine and the kids reluctantly support a needy witch, Nathan struggles to open up about his afterlife and Abaddon tackles fiendish food prep.

videos.title: Ghost Day Out
videos.overview: Nathan discovers something to "live" for on a once-in-a-generation night when ghosts can roam free. Katherine stays in with an almost angelic Abaddon.

videos.title: Astral Esther
videos.overview: After an astral projection mishap, Katherine and Shayna must help Esther find her body. Nathan takes Ben and Abaddon to a mermaid-infested lake.

videos.title: Dante Crowe
videos.overview: Gunslinging ghosthunter Dante Crowe checks in, dragging the family into a fight against world-ending omens. Abaddon answers the call of the wild.

videos.title: The Concierge
videos.overview: Nathan faces the horrors of politics as Esther runs his campaign for Ghost Mayor. A multi-limbed concierge lends Katherine a hand — much to Ben's dismay.

videos.title: The Visit
videos.overview: To save the Undervale, Katherine must recall her first visit to the hotel, when a living Nathan offered her a place to call home amid marital struggles.
